title: Perth–Singapore international backhaul maintenance (2–8 Oct)
current_summary: An upstream network provider is performing subsea cable maintenance on the Perth–Singapore route from Fri 2 Oct 08:00 to Fri 9 Oct 07:00 (UTC+8). During this window, traffic is being rerouted via alternate paths. Customers nationwide may notice higher latency and slower international connectivity to Asia at times; brief interruptions are possible. No action is required.

updates.content: Scheduled maintenance: An upstream provider is repairing a subsea cable on the Perth–Singapore route. Window: Fri 2 Oct 08:00 to Fri 9 Oct 07:00 (UTC+8). We will reroute traffic via alternate paths where available. Some customers may experience higher latency or slower international performance during busy periods, and brief interruptions are possible. No action is required.
